title: JAD remote entry
description: <remotes folder>/<name>.json: another JAD server this one may call with profile_message, subagent, profile (info only), transcript and transcripts. The file name (without .json) is the remote's name, written remote:<name>/... in a tool call. It holds no model, tools or instructions, and never the token itself. A BINDING: one server and one workspace on it (remote.workspace, required); it has no credential: the caller's key (G/auth/keys/<key>.json, see remote-key.schema.json, named in remote_keys of workspace.json, a session or a profile) supplies the token, and token_env, token_file and default_session were removed with workspace layout v1 and are refused; a session is always written in the address, remote:<name>/<session>/<category>/<profile>. A remote is reached over plain http or a unix socket: the bearer token travels in clear text over http, so put that connection behind a VPN or use a unix socket. There is no TLS and no proxy.

url.description: http://host[:port] or unix:///absolute/path.sock. https is refused. No path, query, fragment or credentials. The token of an http url travels in clear text. A unix socket or a loopback address is treated as a server on this machine (its sub-agent calls take the local checkpoint and run to their end); this is a heuristic about the address, not confinement: a name or LAN address of this machine, a tunnel, or a shared file system is not detected.

workspace.description: The id of the workspace on that server this binding reaches, as the server's /api/workspaces lists it. A second workspace on the same server is a second binding. The server's token row for the caller's key must name the same workspace.

max_response_bytes.description: Largest response body accepted; a larger one is an error, never a cut. A run view asks for no more text than fits this size (JSON-escaped), and the whole answer of a cut view is read from the remote in parts of this size into the async result file. Default 1048576.

retries.description: Retries of a request that failed to connect or got a 5xx (a send repeats with the same request id, so the remote never starts it twice). Default 2.

max_in_flight.description: Most requests to this remote at the same time. Default 8.

poll_ms.description: Longest one status poll of a remote run waits on the remote. Default 20000.

lost_after_ms.description: How long a remote run may be unreachable before its handle becomes lost. Default 60000.

profiles.description: Globs of category/name (no [classes]; '*' does not cross '/') that narrow what a model here may reach on this remote (never widens the remote token's own rights).
